dedupe_keys.name: doe office of electricity open energy data portal hosted by ornl outage data hosting capacity maps and grid datasets

description: The Open Energy Data Portal, run by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the US Department of Energy Office of Electricity on Opendatasoft, lists 183 datasets, read on 2026-09-26; users without an account can browse and access datasets, and the portal hosts the Outage Data Initiative Nationwide (ODIN), a grid event signature library dashboard and agent-based control projects. Datasets reached through a substations search show its mix: links to Arkansas utility GIS layers (substations, service territories, power plants, pipelines), feeder hosting capacity maps from Unitil in Massachusetts, United Illuminating's EV load hosting capacity by circuit (74,000 segments), Central Hudson battery storage hosting capacity, the City of Mesa's monthly outage export from the APPA eReliability tool with SAIDI and SAIFI and causes, and sample experiments from ORNL's Digital Ledger Technology project with normal, fault and cyber events. Access is free; licences are set per dataset and many state none, as they mirror utility maps. Caveats: several entries are link-outs with no records. Simulation uses are outage histories for resilience studies and hosting capacity inputs for capacity planning. Related records: data-odin-real-time-outages-county and data-iowa-distribution-test-systems come from this portal.
licence: licences vary per dataset (for example Public Domain for the California Energy Commission layers)
